outcome: Any adverse maternal or neonatal outcome
cohort: 320 nulliparous women with gestational hypertension undergoing induction of labor ≥37 weeks
finding: Early-term induction of labor in nulliparous women with gestational hypertension was not associated with an increased risk of cesarean delivery compared to induction at ≥39 weeks.
mod_finding: Early term induction of labor in nulliparous women with gestational hypertension was not associated with an increased risk of cesarean delivery compared to induction of labor at ≥39 weeks.
